name: Tristacher See
kurzbeschreibung: Lake Tristacher See near Lienz is East Tyrol's sole natural bathing lake at 821 m beneath the Lienz Dolomites, featuring a public lido, woodland loop, and dining.
preis: Lakeshore loop freely accessible; public beach lido approx. €6-7; parking approx. €4-5
oeffnungszeiten: Lakeside path accessible year-round; bathing beach operates May to September
beschreibung:
Überblick

The picturesque Lake Tristacher See rests at an elevation of 821 metres nestled within thick coniferous forests directly beneath the vertical towers of the Lienz Dolomites in the municipality of Tristach, merely four kilometres south of East Tyrol's capital Lienz. As East Tyrol's only natural swimming tarn, this 5.5-hectare body of water with depths reaching 7.5 metres enjoys immense affection among holidaymakers and locals alike. Thanks to its sheltered hollow, the pure mountain water warms swiftly in high summer to agreeable temperatures between 22 and 24 degrees Celsius. On the southern shore, the public beach lido features manicured sunbathing lawns, leafy beech groves, swimming rafts, diving docks, and beach volleyball facilities. On the northern bank, the historic Parkhotel Tristachersee harmonizes with the forest shoreline. At dawn and dusk, the glowing limestone ramparts of the Laserzwand mirror flawlessly across the quiet obsidian surface.

Route & Anforderungen

Circling Lake Tristacher See is an easy woodland stroll covering 1.5 kilometres, taking roughly 30 to 45 minutes of level walking. The nature path traces soft forest loam and wooden footbridges right along the water's edge. Benches and wooden recliners offer restful vantage points facing the dolomite crags. Walkers can also depart straight from Lienz via signposted meadows and pine groves (approx. one hour walk one way). The perimeter loop is level, broad, and suitable for all-terrain prams and seniors; casual sneakers suffice.

Besuch & Anreise

Access from Lienz takes under ten minutes via the federal Drautalstraße B100 and regional roads to Tristach, where designated pay parking is provided. During summer months, the free municipal beach shuttle bus ('Bäderbus') connects downtown Lienz directly to the lakefront.

Tipps

Visit the lake terrace of the Parkhotel Tristachersee in the late afternoon to witness the iconic 'Alpenglow' tinting the sheer limestone walls in vibrant rose hues while savoring traditional apricot dumplings.
